answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The mirror lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the voyage is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
